data.name: Trailbreaker
data.description: A transporter constantly works to obscure his trail. He increases the Survival DC to track him, or a group of which he is a part, by %1. This does not stack with similar abilities, such as a traceless operative's trackless ability (see page 30).|max(1,RangerLVL/2
